steps.body: Stories hide the operation inside words: spending takes away, raising adds, and a two-step story does both before it is finished.
steps.narration: Stories hide the operation inside words: spending takes away, raising adds, and a two-step story does both before it is finished.

widget.prompt: The fund had 640 dollars, spent 180, then raised 120. Slide to estimate what is left.
widget.successFeedback: About 580 — down 180, then up 120, landing a little below the starting 640.
widget.lowFeedback: Too low — spending 180 from 640 still leaves well over 400, and the bake sale adds more.
widget.highFeedback: Too high — the fund cannot end above where it started after spending more than it raised.

predict.prompt: The fund spends 180, then raises 120. Does it end above or below its start?

options.label: Below — it spent more than it raised

predict.reveal: Out 180 and in 120 is a net loss of 60, so the fund lands 60 short of where it began. Money really did come in at the end — but the 120 raised cannot cover the 180 that already left.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and watch what each trade does to g3a story.
invariants: A trade never changes how much there is — ten ones become one ten, one hundred becomes ten tens, and the total stands still while the packaging changes for g3a story.
misconceptions: Flipping a column to take the small digit from the large one, stranding a carry, or borrowing from a column that has nothing to lend.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: If a column comes up short, what must change somewhere else so the total stays exactly the same?

widget.prompt: The trail fund had 485 dollars. The club spent 154 dollars on signs, then raised 57 dollars at the bake sale. How many dollars now?

commonErrors.feedback: The bake sale ADDED money; subtracting it twice sends the fund the wrong way.
Spending 154 takes money out — that step subtracts before the raise adds.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Work one place at a time, and trade only when a column truly comes up short.

A hundred went missing in the carry — check the tens column before you commit.
